args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of a ten-span precast continuous girder bridge (10 × 25 m spans, deck width 12.5 m, 4 prestressed small-box girders per span).

Key decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d; system: continuous (precast made continuous, no pier column data → bearings on rigid supports).
- Girder section: integrated small-box middle girder → A_single = 1.0605 m², I_single = 0.25166 m⁴; combined (×4): A = 4.2421 m², I = 1.00663 m⁴. C50 Ec = 34500 MPa, γ = 26.0 kN/m³, w = 110.294 kN/m, m = 11.243 t/m (self-weight only).
- Bearings: 8 per support line (2/girder end × 4 girders). Abutments 0, 10 and Piers 1–4, 7–9 are PTFE sliding (Kv = 1.133e7 kN/m, Kh = 0, longitudinal free). Piers 5 and 6 are plain laminated elastomeric fixed (Kv = 1.133e7 kN/m, Kh = 26250 kN/m); S = 10.096 for all (300×350 mm, 4 × 8 mm layers).
- Live load: Class I, 3 lanes, ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 310 kN per span. Modal analysis gave f1 = 4.415 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.247.

The model executed successfully with L1/L2/L3 checks passing; self-weight and lane-load envelopes were computed.
